newsitem.title: UK: BFI up four as Panamaxes steady.
newsitem.headline: BFI up four as Panamaxes steady.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose four points to 1,427 on Monday, the first rise since Nov 13.
Brokers said Panamaxes were looking steadier with Cargill, fixing, amongst others, the Marquesa 70,000 dwt delivery Passero retrospective to November 24 for a trans-Atlantic round at $11,500 daily.
In the Pacific Navix fixed Nord Moritz 72,500 dwt direct continuation delivery Japan early December for a Pacific round at $12,200 daily.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX 15 to 25 points higher reflecting the physical market and turnover totalled 75 lots.
